evidence.text: evidence noun. Facts or signs that show clearly that something exists or is true. Example: There is no evidence that the treatment works.

research.text: research noun. Serious study of a subject in order to discover new facts or test new ideas. Example: Recent research shows that sleep affects memory.

arbitrary.text: arbitrary adjective. Decided or arranged without any reason or plan, often unfairly. Example: The rules seemed completely arbitrary. Example: Students should not be judged by arbitrary standards.
